scope: Actual browser/HTTP/encrypted persistence using saved fictional observations. New classification inference is separately measured.
checks: categories filter real account options; category change needs an explicit account; Escape cancels without a save and restores focus
quick account change persists across reload and changes no other draft field
optimistic-lock conflict preserves entered selection and never overwrites a concurrent edit
changing a confirmed account returns it to review, voids its posting and preserves the old/new audit history
detail form uses the same two-level selector and protects unsaved edits from a quick change
reconfirmed new account is retained in actual generic/freee/MF/Yayoi CSV responses
two-level account dialog fits a375px viewport and supports keyboard dismissal
catalog category filtering and a categorized custom account feed the live two-level picker
